item.description: The Western Front of World War I concentrated its devastation in certain parts of France, Belgium, Luxembourg, and Germany. item.description: Happy Groundhog Day, everyone! I hope the weather is overcast where you are, so the local groundhog won't see his shadow and be scared back into his den for six more weeks. item.title: Rare Disease Keeps Cat From Growing
item.description: Grub is not a normal cat. He has a genetic disorder that's quite rare in cats, so rare that medical specialists are studying him to learn about it. You might imagine that it's less rare than they know, because most cats with mucopolysaccharidosis wouldn't survive long enough to be properly diagnosed.Stephanie took Grub in as a foster cat through the rescue organization Good Mews in Georgia. item.description: A few years ago, we posted some contenders for the earliest-born person to be photographed. item.title: The Clever Way K-Pop Makes Two Languages Cool
item.description: K-Pop music arose in the 1990s, but you probably didn't know that because it was in Korea, and it was sung in the Korean language. item.title: The Man Who Flew an Airplane into Space
item.description: The internationally-accepted standard for the altitude at which space begins is the Kármán line, at 100 kilometers or 62 miles above sea level. NASA will bestow astronaut status on anyone who flies above 50 miles. NASA test pilot Joseph A. Walker flew an airplane into space. item.title: Draco Malfoy Is the Mascot of the Chinese New Year
item.description: Images of Draco Malfoy, one of the characters in the Harry Potter franchise, are appearing across China. Why? It's not because of his charming personality and inspiring heroics. item.title: The Gruesome History of the Whaling Industry
item.description: Under normal circumstances, a job pays more when it's difficult, dangerous, or disgusting. Whale hunting is all three, so it wouldn't have ever been attempted if it weren't insanely lucrative. But in addition, it was also risky because there was always the possibility of not catching a whale, which meant no money at all.
